purpose: Define how Metafxclub AI Agent HQ can add temporary or permanent agents without letting the frontend create uncontrolled workers.

spawn_request_schema.missionId: mission id that needs the worker
spawn_request_schema.memoryScope: mission-only summary unless promoted by Manager

lifecycle: Manager detects workload or specialist gap.
Manager creates a spawn request with a bounded goal, TTL, and tool budget.
Risk Guard checks blocked actions and approval requirements.
Backend/local runner writes the runtime agent record and audit event.
Frontend renders the new agent from the approved runtime record.
Agent writes reports to mission, prop, and memory stores.
Manager retires, archives, or promotes the worker.
frontend_rule: Frontend may show the Add Agent button later, but it must only submit a spawn intent to the backend. It must not mint workers or tool permissions by itself.
